title: MCP find_student Response
description: Serving-integrity contract U11/R15: `tools/mcp_server.py`'s `find_student` tool response, built by `_serialize_lookup`. U4: an exact-match-only lookup (orchestrator/identity.py's IdentityRegistry.find_student, no fuzzy/partial matching) — returns the opaque student_id on a match, never the attributes that were looked up (the caller already has those).

found.description: Whether the given attributes matched an existing registration.

student_id.description: The matched student_id, or null when found is false. "pattern" only constrains string instances under JSON Schema semantics, so a null value is unaffected by it.
